journey.name: manual coin selection has no auto row
journey.description:
Verifies the manual coin selection screen lists only the wallet's UTXOs, with no "Auto" row, and that Continue follows TOTAL SELECTED against TOTAL REQUIRED (synonymdev/bitkit-android#894).
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with at least 3 on-chain Savings UTXOs, one of them smaller than the 10 000 sat send plus fee and together covering it. Fund through `./lsp` with 2-3 small deposits to a Savings address and mine a block. Start on the wallet home screen. The send uses your own Savings address (Settings > Advanced > Address Viewer); nothing is broadcast.
Tapping the amount on the amount screen swaps the primary display unit. Do not tap it.

actions.action: Open Settings, then the "Advanced" tab (testTag "Tab-advanced"), then "Coin Selection" (testTag "CoinSelectPreference")
Tap "Manual" (testTag "manual_button") and go back to the home screen
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<own savings address>?amount=0.0001" to.bitkit.dev`
Verify the amount screen shows 10 000 sats and tap Continue (testTag "ContinueAmount")
Verify the coin selection screen (testTag "coin_selection_screen") is visible
Verify there is no element with testTag "auto_select_row" and no row labelled "Auto"
Verify one row per UTXO (testTag prefix "utxo_row_") is listed, largest value first, and every switch is on (screenshot)
Verify TOTAL SELECTED equals the sum of all listed UTXOs and is at least TOTAL REQUIRED
Tap UTXO rows from the top until TOTAL SELECTED is below TOTAL REQUIRED
Tap the last deselected UTXO row again so TOTAL SELECTED is at least TOTAL REQUIRED
Verify the Confirm screen (testTag "ReviewAmount") shows 10 000 sats
Go back until the send sheet closes, without swiping to pay
Open Settings, then the "Advanced" tab, then "Coin Selection", and tap "Autopilot" (testTag "autopilot_button") to restore the default
